direction.camera: Guide attention with color field; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: one saturated field supports a single contrasting subject; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with saturated backdrop; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with one accent.
direction.lighting: even cyclorama; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: painted enamel and solid pigment; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around measured cut; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use color field,saturated backdrop,isolated product,graphic contrast,measured cut,one accent as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
